question: Should openclawProgressKind with the tool-progress value become a supported public Plugin SDK contract, or remain an internal bundled Codex-to-channel signal?
rationale: The implementation requires a permanent cross-plugin ownership and compatibility choice that tests cannot settle; public SDK exposure affects external plugin expectations beyond this Slack bug fix.

options.title: Approve and document the generic contract
options.body: Keep the additive public marker, document intended producers and consumers plus stability expectations, and add focused Plugin SDK compatibility coverage.

options.title: Internalize the marker
options.body: Move the signal to a bundled-only runtime seam so external plugins cannot depend on a contract intended only for Codex and bundled channels.

options.title: Pause the cross-plugin design
options.body: Do not merge the public API until maintainers choose a different generic progress-presentation model shared by channels.

recommendation.title: Approve and document the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the additive public marker, document intended producers and consumers plus stability expectations, and add focused Plugin SDK compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the current Slack delivery boundary and public Plugin SDK contract, both reflected in recent reviewed history.
